Hey Neighbor,

Just wanted to say hi and let you know that I noticed the new flowers you planted in front of your house. They're absolutely stunning! I especially love the purple ones, they really brighten up the whole street. Keep up the good work - you're making our neighborhood look even better. 

Let me know if there's anything I can help with, like weeding or watering. 

Best,
[Your Name] 

Hope you're doing well too! 
[Optional: Mention something about the weather, a local event, etc. to continue the friendly chat] 

Take care! 🌸🌼

---

Feel free to modify this message to fit your relationship with your neighbor and the local area! 🌟🏡💬

---

This is a friendly, casual message that lets your neighbor know you appreciate what they've done
